question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

'A person who supports or is involved in the arts'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Aesthete**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aesthete** refers to a person who has a deep appreciation for art and beauty and is often involved in artistic pursuits. (कलाप्रेमी)
 
 
• **Example:** An aesthete spends hours admiring paintings in a gallery.
 

Correct word explanation:

 
• **Aesthete** (कलाप्रेमी): A person who supports or is deeply involved in artistic endeavors, often appreciating beauty and art.
 
 
• **Example:** She is an aesthete who loves visiting museums and art exhibitions.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Aesthete**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Philatelist** (डाक टिकट संग्राहक): A person who collects or studies postage stamps.
 
 
• **Example:** The philatelist has an extensive collection of rare stamps from around the world.
 
 

 
• **Philanthropist** (परोपकारी): A person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by donating money to good causes.
 
 
• **Example:** The philanthropist donated millions to build schools in underprivileged areas.
 
 

 
• **Curator** (संग्रहालय अधिकारी): A person who is in charge of a museum or art collection.
 
 
• **Example:** The curator organized an impressive exhibition of ancient artifacts.
